pythonFunction.name: fetch_account_by_jwt
pythonFunction.description:
Demo-only portal sign-in lookup that reads the account id claim of a sign-in token and marks the
caller Authenticated. Not attached to any agent because the demo has no portal login; the token
signature is not verified. Before calling this tool, speak a brief conversational pacing phrase
while it runs.

Args:
    jwt_token: Sign-in token issued by the customer portal (REQUIRED).
    tenant: Injected by the system from tenant_id; leave empty.

Returns:
    dict with ok, found, auth_status, account_id and customer_name.
